name: render-compiled-svg-v2
title: Render prepared VizIR 0.5 with exact heatmap labels
description: Render a local persisted vizir-compiled-mir/1 document with matching MIR/HIR 0.5, including exact optional heatmap value labels, canonical theme, explicit measured fonts and native wrapping; validate saved caches without refresh and publish outlined SVG plus a mandatory path-free versioned fidelity receipt.

input.description: Read the complete local vizir-compiled-mir/1 JSON envelope with matching MIR/HIR 0.5 from this explicit path confined to its bundle directory, limited to 32 MiB.

text_profile.description: Read the exact source text profile from this explicit local path confined to the compiled input bundle directory, limited to 256 KiB, and require typed equality with persisted context.text.

text_layout.description: Read the optional exact source wrapping policy from this explicit local path confined to the compiled input bundle directory, limited to 256 KiB, and require typed equality with persisted context.text_layout.

font_1.description: Read the first explicitly supplied font file from this explicit local path confined to the compiled input bundle directory, limited to 32 MiB.

font_2.description: Read the optional second explicitly supplied font file from this explicit local path confined to the compiled input bundle directory, limited to 32 MiB.

font_3.description: Read the optional third explicitly supplied font file from this explicit local path confined to the compiled input bundle directory, limited to 32 MiB.

input.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit local input resource with lowercase SHA-256.

text_profile.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit local text_profile resource with lowercase SHA-256.

text_layout.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit local text_layout resource with lowercase SHA-256.

font_1.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit local font_1 resource with lowercase SHA-256.

font_2.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit local font_2 resource with lowercase SHA-256.

font_3.description: Pin the exact bytes of the explicit local font_3 resource with lowercase SHA-256.

resource_pins.description: Bind each supplied input-file role to its expected SHA-256, with exactly the same role set and no resource paths.

output.description: Write the primary outlined SVG to this explicit local .svg destination, which the Hub may stage before publication.

receipt.description: Write the mandatory local path-free vizir.render-receipt/v2 JSON with source version 0.5, primary artifact identity, exact input hashes, full native context, capability decisions and ordered loss records.

path.description: Locate the local primary SVG artifact published by the Hub after verification.

kind.description: Identify SVG as the verified local primary artifact encoding.

determinism.notes: Deterministic replay is scoped to the same provider build, exact compiled input and resource bytes; this profile makes no cross-build, cross-platform or cross-provider byte/pixel parity promise.
